messages.subject: Wraysbury report WML-2025-0042 - CH-280 cells, String B
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Please find our failure-analysis report attached. In summary, the cells failed by reason of manufacturing defects - cathode-coating delamination, inconsistent electrode loading, separator particulate contamination and lithium plating. These are not consistent with installation or thermal-management damage. We recommend you do not energise the affected cells, and that representative cells from Strings A and C from the same campaign are screened before service.

If the report is to be used in proceedings we'll reissue it in CPR Part 35 form with the declaration.

Faisal

Dr Faisal Iqbal | Principal Metallurgist | Wraysbury Materials Laboratory
